stories.title: How Smart Thermostats Cut Heating Costs
stories.description: This story explains how smart thermostats reduce heating costs by learning habits and controlling temperature efficiently.

scenes.visual_prompt: Quiet living room in winter, thermostat mounted on wall, soft morning light, calm environment, slow ambient motion, subtle camera drift
scenes.visual_reference: A wall-mounted smart thermostat in a calm living room
scenes.narration: Heating systems often run longer than needed, quietly wasting energy throughout the day.

scenes.visual_prompt: Smart thermostat screen glowing softly, temperature adjusting slightly, gentle movement, stable framing
scenes.narration: Smart thermostats automatically adjust temperature, reducing heat when comfort is not required.

scenes.visual_prompt: Time passing from day to night inside a home, lights dimming, heating subtly lowering, smooth transition
scenes.visual_reference: A home interior transitioning from day to night
scenes.narration: By learning daily routines, the system predicts when heating can safely turn down.

scenes.visual_prompt: Smartphone resting on table with thermostat app open, slow directional motion, minimal graphics
scenes.visual_reference: A phone displaying temperature controls connected to the thermostat
scenes.narration: Sensors and mobile controls allow adjustments even when no one is home.

scenes.visual_prompt: Outdoor temperature changing from cold to milder conditions, subtle activity, steady framing
scenes.narration: Weather data helps the thermostat respond efficiently to changing outdoor conditions.

scenes.visual_prompt: Family returning home, warm lights turning on, heating gently increasing, calm atmosphere
scenes.visual_reference: People entering a comfortably warm home
scenes.narration: Heating increases only when needed, keeping rooms comfortable without unnecessary energy use.

scenes.visual_prompt: Thermostat steady at an efficient temperature, quiet home at night, slow camera drift, relaxed lighting
scenes.visual_reference: A thermostat holding a stable temperature in a peaceful home
scenes.narration: Through small, intelligent adjustments, smart thermostats lower heating costs while maintaining everyday comfort.
